parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because this parameter will be removed in the future.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that it is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** parameter can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: PageNum
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than **0** and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **30**, **50**, and **100**. Default value: **30**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the change tracking instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~49442~~).

parameters.name: SubscriptionInstanceName
parameters.description:
The name of the change tracking instance.

>  If you specify this parameter, DTS returns all the change tracking instances that match the specified name.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: Tags of the data migration instance, used as a filter. When this is not empty, only instances with this tag will be returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts describe-subscription-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-size 30 --page-num 1 --subscription-instance-name 'MySQL订阅' --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000 --account-id 123233440000 --tag Value=testvalue1 Key=testkey1 --resource-group-id rg-aekz4us4iruleja --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts DescribeSubscriptionInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key testkey1 --SubscriptionInstanceName 'MySQL订阅' --AccountId 123233440000 --PageSize 30 --PageNum 1 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-aekz4us4iruleja' --Tag.1.Value testvalue1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000'
